content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: after the \"Hedge Relationship\" menu item is clicked, a coverage overlay appears and stays up for about 10 s before the hedge relationship screen navigation completes, which suggests the screen waits on work it does before rendering; no network or console error appears in the windows to explain the delay.", "fix": "Fix: In the Hedging menu's \"Hedge Relationship\" item handler, start the route change to the hedge relationship screen immediately and move its blocking data load into the screen so the loading overlay is dismissed as soon as the screen mounts, then measure the time from the click to the app:4 navigation event.", "cited_event_ids": ["24", "29:w28", "app:4", "35:x37", "25", "30:w31", "35:x40"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The cause of the ~10 s delay between the overlay appearing and the navigation event is not visible in the events; no request or timing data is included.", "The 11 clicks/keys counted during the waits are not individually visible in the windows, which show only focus and pointer events during the wait.", "Whether the Trade Date errors (48:a51, 52:a56, 52:a58, 57:a68) relate to the wait is not established; they occur after the overlay is removed.", "Whether the overlay itself blocks input during the wait is not confirmed by the events."]}
